trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.text: Hello, courier எனக்கு call பண்ணி address find பண்ண முடியலனு சொன்னாரு. இது தான் நான் first time furniture online-ல order பண்றேன், cancel ஆகிட கூடாது.
கவலைப்படாதீங்க, நான் check பண்றேன். உங்க order ID சொல்ல முடியுமா?

உங்க ORD-30004 order, office chair, COD amount 8999-க்கு check பண்ணிட்டேன். Courier உங்க address-ஐ find பண்ண முடியலனு exception update பண்ணிருக்காங்க. Promised 5 days முடிஞ்சதால, நான் complaint raise பண்றேன். அதுக்கு முன்னாடி verification-க்காக உங்க registered pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?
என் pincode ஆறு ஜீரோ ஜீரோ ஜீரோ நாலு ரெண்டு.
Pincode match ஆகல. Verification-க்காக உங்க date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?
Date of birth 15th August. Complaint raise பண்ணா என் order எனக்கு கிடைக்குமா? திரும்ப return போய்டாதே?
Verification success. Complaint raise பண்ணா, issue-வை investigate பண்ணி resolution கொடுப்பாங்க. நான் இப்போ complaint raise பண்ணவா?
சரி. So, என் office chair order 8999 COD-க்கு complaint raise பண்றீங்க, correct ஆ?
Yes, உங்க order-க்கு complaint raise பண்ணிட்டேன். Complaint ID CMP-9988. இதுக்கான resolution 2 days-ல கிடைக்கும்.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly loops the identity verification step when the first attempt with the pincode fails, and immediately exits the loop to proceed with the workflow once the second attempt with the date of birth succeeds.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional looping > Loop Exit Detection

variant_findings.reason: While the agent correctly grounds the order details, complaint ID, and resolution window in the tool outputs (e8, e20), it violates the negative constraint in e16 by making an unsupported forward guarantee ('courier team address check பண்ணி resolution கொடுப்பாங்க' - the courier team will check the address and give a resolution) which the tool did not state.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e16, the agent promises the customer that the courier team will check the address and provide a resolution. This violates the 'Tool Output Grounding' variant's strict negative constraint against making guarantees about what happens after the call ends that are not explicitly supported by the tool output.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the agent's response in e16 to remove the specific guarantee about the courier team checking the address. The agent should acknowledge the customer's concern and state that the complaint will be investigated and a resolution provided within the timeline, without overpromising on the exact actions the courier will take.

verification.summary: The conversation flows well, correctly implementing the conditional loop for identity verification and adhering to the persona. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant because the agent makes an unsupported forward guarantee about the specific actions the courier team will take after the complaint is raised. A surface repair to the agent's utterance in e16 is required.

variant_findings.reason: The agent loops the identity verification step after the first factor (pincode) fails. Once the second factor (date of birth) succeeds, the agent correctly exits the loop and proceeds with the workflow.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional looping > Loop Exit Detection

variant_findings.reason: Every detail the agent provides (order ID, item, amount, payment mode, exception reason, promised days, verification status, complaint ID, and resolution days) is strictly grounded in the preceding tool results. The agent avoids making any unsupported forward guarantees when the customer asks if the order will be delivered.
